svg.title: YuE2 generator training: historical plain and particle recipes

cc:Work.dc:title: YuE2 generator training: historical plain and particle recipes
cc:Work.dc:description: All logged updates, with no smoothing. The original plain LoRA spikes at step 373. The slower plain control is also stable in this window; this is not a particle-only ablation.
